Commit and push changes across every student repo

Source: R/github.R
push_repos.Rd

Iterates over each enrolled student's local clone at dir/<prefix>-<netID> and, for any repo with uncommitted changes, stages everything, commits with message, and pushes. Repos with no changes are left untouched, so this is safe to run repeatedly (e.g. weekly as assignments are graded).

push_repos(
  roster,
  org,
  message,
  dir = here::here(),
  prefix = org,
  clone_missing = FALSE,
  gitignore = ".DS_Store",
  dry_run = FALSE
)

Arguments

roster

Course roster data frame with netID and enrolled.

org

GitHub organization the repos live in.

message

Commit message (required).

dir

Directory containing the local clones. Defaults to here::here().

prefix

Repo-name prefix. Defaults to org.

clone_missing

If TRUE, clone any repo not present locally before committing. Defaults to FALSE.

gitignore

Character vector of .gitignore lines to seed into any repo lacking a .gitignore. Defaults to ".DS_Store". Use NULL to skip seeding.

dry_run

If TRUE, print what would happen without writing, cloning, committing, or pushing.

Value

Invisibly, a tibble with one row per enrolled student and a status column (pushed, nochange, skipped, failed, cloned, or a would_* value under dry_run).

Details

Requires the gh CLI installed and authenticated, and gh auth setup-git run once so git push works non-interactively.
